study type: Single blinded, parallel randomized controlled trial
outcome: Duration of first stage of labor
cohort: 200 primigravid women at 30 weeks of gestation onward
finding: Prenatal yoga was associated with reduced labor pain, lower rates of labor induction and analgesia, higher rates of normal vaginal delivery, shorter first stage of labor, and improved maternal comfort.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were lower in the yoga group.
